description: The frame of every form control (DESIGN.md, Field): FieldLabel above, child, then the hint or the error below (replacing the hint), read together with child by a screen reader. Every tsuya input builds this in (`label:`, `hint:`, `error:`, `optional:`, `required:`); wrap a custom control in it directly.

constructors.description: A frame around child, labelled label.

params.name: hint
params.description: Shown under child when there is no error.

params.name: error
params.description: Shown under child instead of hint, with the alert glyph; also marks child invalid in semantics.

params.name: optional
params.description: Appends the optional marker to label.

params.name: required
params.description: Marks child as required in semantics; drawn no differently (not marked visually).
